name: Opal's Monster
source:
[b]How much will you sacrifice to keep from being alone?[/b]

You play as Opal. You've got the high-level job, the great friends, the brand-new house, the perfect life. Why, you've got it all... except a boyfriend. 

Armed with forbidden alchemy, chemistry, and biology, you're willing to change that. One abomination against nature at a time.

[From [url=https://riderofblack.itch.io/opals-monster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]为了不再孤身一人，你究竟愿意付出多少代价？[/b]

你将扮演欧泊。体面的高薪工作、合拍的挚友、崭新的大房子、完美顺遂的人生——你可谓应有尽有……唯独缺了一个男朋友。

手握禁忌炼金术、化学与生物学知识的你，决意亲手改变这一现状——哪怕每尝试一次，就要造出一头违背自然法则的扭曲怪物。

[摘自[url=https://riderofblack.itch.io/opals-monster]itch.io[/url]]
